rules.title: uv add, not pip
rules.text: Add dependencies with uv add so pyproject.toml and the lockfile stay in sync. Never use pip install in a uv project.

rules.title: Locked runs
rules.text: Run tools with uv run --locked, which fails if the lock is stale. Use --frozen only when the lock must not be checked.

rules.title: Upgrade one package
rules.text: Upgrade a single package with uv lock --upgrade-package <name> instead of upgrading everything.

rules.title: No system Python
rules.text: Never use the system python3 or a bare pip for project work. Go through uv and the project environment.

rules.title: PEP 723 scripts
rules.text: Write self-contained scripts with PEP 723 inline metadata and run them with uv run script.py.

rules.title: Avoid uv pip install
rules.text: Avoid uv pip install inside a uv project. It bypasses the lockfile.

rules.title: Docker sync layers
rules.text: In Docker, sync dependencies with --frozen in the cached layer and with --locked in the final sync.

rules.title: Pin the interpreter
rules.text: Pin the interpreter with .python-version or requires-python and let uv manage it.

rules.title: Workspaces
rules.text: Use uv workspaces for multi-package repos with a single lockfile.

rules.title: uvx for one-off tools
rules.text: Run one-off tools with uvx instead of installing them globally.
